title: basivo-operator settings
description: Per-user configuration for the basivo-operator plugin (allowlist + risk + logging).

audit_log_path.description: Absolute path for the redacted action log. Empty = default <plugin-data>/.basivo-operator/audit.log.

default_publish_requires_explicit_immedi.description: If true, publish is never chained onto a draft on prior authorization unless the user said 'publish immediately' AND the site risk_level permits it.

high_risk_enabled.description: Required true to operate a high-risk site; otherwise the domain hook denies navigation.
